description_en: Creates a service-linked role (SLR) and a Log Service project
description_zh: 调用CreateSlrAndSlsProject创建服务关联角色（SLR）以及日志服务（SLS）项目
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn create-slr-and-sls-project --biz-region cn-shanghai --business-type cdn_log_access_l1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSlrAndSlsProject

parameters.help_en:
The region where Log Service resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou

cn-shanghai

cn-qingdao

cn-beijing

cn-zhangjiakou

cn-shenzhen

eu-central-1

us-west-1

ap-south-1

ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务所在区域，取值范围：

cn-hangzhou
cn-shanghai
cn-qingdao
cn-beijing
cn-zhangjiakou
cn-shenzhen
eu-central-1
us-west-1
ap-south-1
ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn_log_access_l1. Valid values:

cdn_log_access_l1: access logs of L1 Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

cdn_log_origin: back-to-origin logs

cdn_log_er: EdgeRoutine logs
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，取值：

cdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：用户访问日志。
cdn_log_er：边缘程序日志。
cdn_log_waf：WAF拦截日志
parameters.name: business_type
